questions.cardText:
[Psychology] What is the name of the effect where people overestimate their ability in certain areas?
A. Dunning-Kruger Effect
B. Pygmalion Effect
C. Hawthorne Effect
Answer: A. This cognitive bias can cause less competent people to overestimate their skills while more competent people underestimate theirs in comparison to others.
questions.de: Wie heißt die kognitive Verzerrung, bei der Menschen mit geringen Fähigkeiten auf einem Gebiet ihre Kompetenz darin stark überschätzen?
questions.en: What is the name of the cognitive bias in which people with low skill in an area greatly overestimate their competence in it?

timeline.labelEn: Psychologists David Dunning and Justin Kruger formalise and study the effect
timeline.labelDe: Die Psychologen David Dunning und Justin Kruger beschreiben und untersuchen den Effekt erstmals

questions.notes: Card's wording 'people overestimate their ability' is too broad (that is illusory superiority in general); the effect is specifically about low performers, so the question says so.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What does a one-point increase in the Richter Scale represent?
A. A twofold increase in amplitude
B. A tenfold increase in amplitude
C. A hundred increase in amplitude
Answer: B. Each whole number increase on the Richter Scale represents a tenfold increase in the amplitude of seismic waves and roughly 31.6 times (square root of 1,000) more energy released.
questions.de: Um welchen Faktor nimmt die gemessene Amplitude der Erdbebenwellen mit jeder ganzen Stufe der Richterskala zu?
questions.en: By what factor does the measured seismic-wave amplitude increase with each whole-number step on the Richter scale?

timeline.labelEn: Charles Richter introduces his earthquake magnitude scale
timeline.labelDe: Charles Richter führt seine Skala für die Stärke von Erdbeben ein

questions.notes: Confirmed: tenfold amplitude and about 31.6× energy per whole step (Wikipedia). Option C 'A hundred increase' is the card's typo for 'hundredfold'.
